steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Get lost! You wanna try being electrocuted again?!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Urgh... Mmm...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Just torture me... Don't you even... Don't you even dare touch her finger!!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Mirror... Mirror... I think I have met a real hero.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: My body still hurts, but those dark, scary memories... seem to have disappeared.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: My hero is trying to save me, so I have to... try my best... to get out... of here!!
Is this...?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray...
The shackles finally take effect. The young girl lies in the bathtub for a long, long time, trying to calm down. She finally sits up, her eyes filled with tears that slowly trickle down.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I'm sorry, Ray... I forgot so much...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Sorry... that you had to take it all on your own...
Luvia? Is... it you?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Yes... It's me...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I remember now. My hero... My Ray...
Luvia buries her face in her hands as she weeps and calls out to Ray.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Girls died every day in that hell... I was so scared, so scared that I'd be next.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I-I made wishes in the mirror. I pleaded with the above to save me. There are so many heroes in the movies, why can't I have one?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray. Ray became my hero. She bore all the pain and the memories of despair on her own.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Even... Even though Ray was terrified too...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: She... she is worried that I'll be in that situation again. And that's why she doesn't want me to be an actress...
You pat Luvia's shoulder to offer her some comfort.
Everything's fine now, Luvia. If you could escape from the hell last time, you can do it this time.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: B-but how? I don't know how to use that ability...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: It's Ray who's been protecting me every time. Now it's my turn to protect her, but I've no idea how I can do that.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Why am I so useless... I...
Seeing that Luvia is about to have another breakdown, you whisper to her hurriedly.
It might have been the shackles, but I seem to have had a glimpse of a tip of your memories.
Ray is very brave indeed, but you also made an incredible effort at that time.

options: She was asking you for help.

choices.text: She was asking you for help.

steps.content: When Ray was unconscious and needed help the most, the person she sought help from... was you.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray... asking me for help?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Wh-Why me...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray was the one who got us out of that hell...

options: You two are each other's heroes.

choices.text: You two are each other's heroes.

steps.content: But perhaps... you two are each other's heroes.
Your words make Luvia widen her eyes. She jerks up from the bathtub as if something has come to mind.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Each other's heroes...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Did Ray honestly think that...?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: She's so brave, so strong, and she's been shielding me from all the harm...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: What did I do that made Ray think this...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I'm so useless, ho-how exactly did I save Ray?
It's okay if you can't remember. You can create a memory of "saving Ray" right now, like how you wanted to get her approval through being successful in auditions.
Luvia walks out of the bathtub and stands before you. Though her previous words were full of sorrow and doubt.
Now, Luvia's eyes become tough, and a glow like lightning flashes in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: You're right, Chief.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I'm going to... I'm going to save Ray!
Under your instructions, Luvia unties your hands and leads you to the iron door in the room.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I... I'll try my best to control that ability.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I've never used it and find the ability very scary... but for the sake of Ray, I'll try my best!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I'll try my best and get us out of here together!
Sparks start to gather at Luvia's fingertips, along which comes crackling noise.
The noise startles Luvia and makes her shoulders flinch. But then she takes a look at you and that battered bathtub, and bites her lip.
Don't be afraid, Luvia. I'm here...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Mmm!
Electricity bursts out of Luvia's hands in a flash, through which all the power strikes the door.

steps.speaker: Sound of Explosion
steps.content: Bang—!!
With an incredibly loud explosion, Luvia's electricity blasts away an entire wall of the small room.
Luvia... You're... very impressive indeed...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Wh-What just happened?! It's so scary! Goodness...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: H-How did I get such a terrifying ability?!!!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Crying...
Luvia, if you were like this in the audition just now...
Perhaps the leading actress would've been you.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: What...?
Well, this isn't the time for it.
You're already a hero who saved Ray and me. Do you want to be a hero for more people now?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: More people... You mean the girls who're going through what I went through?
Luvia looks at you with a brighter gleam in her eyes, then she wipes her face hard and stands up.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Chief, take me to save more people!
Sure. Let's go, hero!
You lead Luvia to search room by room to rescue the girls who're imprisoned. When you see people filming, Luvia electrocutes them and ties them up.
Until you two finally see the man who plunged Luvia and Ray to hell.
Having recovered all the memories, Luvia can't help stepping back and her hands shiver at the sight of this man.

options: Luvia, he's no match for you.

choices.text: Luvia, he's no match for you.

steps.content: You are not the girl who only has a pretty face at the mercy of others.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I... I know.
The director looks at Luvia and you as he reaches toward the radio on the wall. He's probably trying to call for help.
Before you finish speaking, Luvia has already shot high-voltage electricity at that radio. She clearly understands that she can't let the enemy seek help.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Ouch—Electricity? I remember it now. So you're the girl they met the other day, the one with special ability...

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: But... I've seen you even before that, haven't I?

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: You bastard!

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: You are just a Z-list anyway. You might as well shoot these films with me. Maybe some big guns will notice you this way.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Plus, I heard my bosses prefer people with odd abilities like you and you can sell for more money... Is it for both of you? But I'm not sure if they would want a man...
steps.female_content: Hehe, I heard my bosses prefer people with odd abilities like you and you can sell for more money... Is it for both of you?

steps.content: The man rolls his eyes at you and clearly has no intention to answer. He kicks away the girl next to him who's covered in bruises and turns to Luvia excitedly.

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Chick, you won't end well if you fight against me and us! Don't you dare to run now that you've caught my eyes!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I won't let you hurt Ray and the Chief!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: This time... this time I'm going to protect them!!
The director charges toward Luvia with his bloodshot eyes.
Luvia clearly has no intention to take the man's life. She can't quite do it yet, but the electricity she releases is strong enough to knock out an adult man.
Luvia, there's something wrong with this guy! Watch out!!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Huh? Do... Do I have to kill...
He looks like... It's hard to tell, but he may have strengthened his power with Mania crystals.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Wh-What crystal...
Anyway, be careful. Just deal with him with the strongest means you're willing to use!

steps.speaker: Director
steps.content: Enough crap... Take this!!
Realizing that it's impossible to approach Luvia, the man decides to charge at you who're giving Luvia orders.
He pulls out a dagger from his waist and swings it frantically as it stabs at you along with the sound of the wind.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: No!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I won't let you touch even his finger!!!!!!
steps.female_content: I won't let you touch even her finger!!!!!!

steps.content: Luvia dashes up as she shills.
In a split second, countless sparks blast out from Luvia. The light purple electricity surrounds the man instantly.
Her body quivers slightly, but she's still standing in front of you bravely, just like the hero she imagined back then.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: You've tortured so many girls... giving them dark memories that haunt them for the rest of their lives...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: And you even hurt Ray, you hurt Ray so much! I'll never forgive you!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I hope... you burn in hell!
Luvia raises her hand, on which electricity gathers and grows brighter.
Luvia, hold...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: But I know... You'll have it too easy if you just die like this.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I'll let you taste what hell is like for yourself!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Luvia...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray! Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I'm fine... So you saw that memory, huh? I was hoping you'd never recall it...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: It's my fault that you bore so much on your own...

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: No, it's good that you forgot... One has to move on from the painful darkness.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Let the pain become your armor, but a stumbling block...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray... I can't believe Ray just praised me!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Hmph, you get cocky so easily. Have a look at what a mess you've made around here with your ability first!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Hey! How can you talk like this, Ray?! I'm the one who got us all out!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: The Chief said I did really well the first time using my ability!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: I also beat up those who bullied you!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: That's not the first time you've used the ability.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: What?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: How do you think we got out of that hell?

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Thank you for saving me again, Luvia.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Huff. Hi, Chief. I've finished this training now. What's next?
That's all for today.
It'll be the same training tomorrow morning. Make sure you come.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Chief, can I do the training a little earlier tomorrow morning? The crew wants me to do a few more shots.
Sure. As usual...

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Got it, Chief! The supervisor is going with me as my "agent"!
Since Luvia's identity as a Sinner is known, she has to be supervised here.
But considering Luvia and Ray helped the MBCC capture the criminal organization disguised as a filming company, they are allowed to perform under supervision.
This might not be the life they want most, but to Luvia, what matters the most is that she can keep on acting.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: I really don't understand what more shots a minor role like yours need to do.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Hey! The role has a name! It's a supporting role that lives up to the end of the finale!

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Well done. You only live up to the finale. You don't even star in that many shots.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: One step at a time. If I do it well, I might be the leading actress next time!

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: Ray, if you're sneaking out tonight, don't get too late fighting. I don't want to oversleep tomorrow morning.

steps.speaker: Luvia
steps.content: And please, please make sure you don't hurt the face! Or it'll look awful on camera.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: Stop nagging.

steps.speaker: Ray
steps.content: ...Got it.
